# Requirement
```text
Overall / Domain Description
This is a console pipe-connection game. The game board is a grid surrounded by outer walls. Inside the board there is one source, and on the border there is one sink. The player places pipes from a pipe queue. After an initial delay, water begins to flow through connected pipes.
The board uses zero-based internal array indices. However, index 0 and the last row/column are occupied by the outer wall border. Therefore, the playable area starts from internal index 1 and ends at rows - 2 / cols - 2.
Player-facing coordinates intentionally align with these playable internal indices:
row 1 refers to internal row 1, and column 'A' refers to internal column 1. No row-minus-one or column-minus-one conversion is applied, except that column letters are mapped so that 'A' becomes 1.
Directions include up, down, left, and right. Each direction has a corresponding opposite direction and a unit movement offset(class PA19Helper will help class Direction to provide these functions). Pipe shapes define which directions they connect to. Termination type distinguishes source and sink.

Functional Requirements

Coordinate and Direction
A coordinate stores the internal row and column used directly to access the cell grid. A cell stored at a given grid position should carry the same coordinate value.
Because the outer border occupies index 0, playable cells naturally begin at index 1. This allows user input to align directly with the playable internal grid.
Directions support movement calculations through their unit offsets and can be compared against their opposite direction when checking pipe connectivity.

Game
The game supports placing the current pipe, skipping the current pipe, undoing the latest placement, advancing the water state, checking whether the player has won, checking whether the player has lost, and tracking the number of player steps.
When the player places a pipe, the row value is used directly. The column letter is converted so that 'A' maps to column 1, 'B' maps to column 2, and so on. For example, row 1 and column 'A' target the internal cell at [1][1].
Skipping removes the current pipe from the front of the queue and counts as one step.
Undo restores the latest placed pipe to the front of the queue, clears that pipe from the board, and counts as one step. If there is no previous placement to undo, the operation fails without changing the board.

Map
The map stores cells in a two-dimensional grid with indices from [0..rows-1] and [0..cols-1]. The outermost row and column positions are walls. The playable area is [1..rows-2] by [1..cols-2].
A pipe may be placed only when all of the following are true:
1. The target coordinate is inside the playable area.
2. The target cell is a fillable cell.
3. The target cell does not already contain a pipe.

Cell Family
Cells are parsed from map characters into concrete cell types.
A fillable cell may contain a pipe or be empty. Empty fillable cells render as a dot.
A termination cell represents either the source or the sink. It stores the direction it points toward and whether it has been filled by water.
A wall cell represents the board boundary and renders using the wall character.

Termination Cell Rendering
A termination cell renders as an arrow based on its direction and filled state. Filled and unfilled arrows come from the shared rendering constants.
Both source and sink use their stored pointing direction directly. The direction is not reversed for either type.
Throws IllegalStateException("Invalid pointingTo value!") for unknown direction.

Pipe
A pipe has a shape and a filled state. Its shape determines the directions it connects to.
Supported pipe shapes include horizontal, vertical, the four corner shapes, and cross.
Pipe rendering depends on both shape and filled state. The rendered character should come from the shared rendering constants rather than hardcoded glyphs.
Short pipe codes include HZ, VT, TL, TR, BL, BR, and CR.

Water Flow
At the beginning of water flow, the source is marked as filled.
Water expands outward from the source by distance. Each update increases the reachable fill distance by one.
Water may move from one pipe to an adjacent pipe only when both sides connect to each other: the outgoing direction of one pipe must match the opposite direction of the neighboring pipe.
The filling process follows breadth-first expansion from the source.

Win and Loss Conditions
The player wins if there is a connected path from the source to the sink.
Path checking starts from the source by moving once in the source’s pointing direction. From each pipe, traversal continues through that pipe’s connection directions. The path does not require pipes to already be filled. Reaching the sink means the game is won.
The player loses when a water-flow update fills no new pipes. Loss is checked only after the initial delay has ended and water has actually started advancing.

Pipe Queue
The pipe queue stores upcoming pipes. The player always interacts with the pipe at the front.
When a pipe is consumed, the queue is automatically refilled up to a fixed maximum length using randomly generated pipe shapes.
Undo places the restored pipe back at the front of the queue.

Delay Bar
The delay bar starts with an initial value and decreases once per round.
While the value is still positive, water has not begun flowing. Once the countdown passes zero, the corresponding positive distance indicates how far water should expand from the source.

Cell Stack
The placement history records successfully placed cells in order.
Undo uses the most recent placement. The undo counter represents the number of successful undo actions, not the current size of the placement history.

External / Tool Classes
Pa19Helper is a handwritten helper and assembly class in the pa19 package. It is responsible for constructing core game objects from provided inputs, wiring together the map, pipe queue, delay bar, and placement history. It also centralizes basic parsing and direction utility behavior.
Deserializer is responsible for reading game input from a file and producing runtime game objects. It validates that the input file exists, reads the board size, delay value, map lines, and optional default pipes. If the input ends unexpectedly or an I/O error occurs, it returns no game object and logs the error.
When parsing map text, border cells are treated as sink-side termination candidates, while inner termination symbols are treated as source-side candidates.
Deserializer ignores blank lines and comment lines beginning with # when reading meaningful input.
PipePatterns is a final utility-style constant holder for all rendering characters. It contains the wall character and grouped constants for filled and unfilled arrows and pipe shapes. Rendering logic should rely on these constants instead of hardcoded characters.
StringUtils is a lightweight utility-style class for string helpers and should not be instantiated.
```

# Operation Specifications
PipeQueue::peek
Summary: Returns the pipe at the front of the queue without removing it.
Algorithm: Return the first element of pipeQueue list.
Related Features: pipeQueue field
Related Classes: Pipe
Input: None
Output: Pipe - the front pipe in the queue
Pre-condition: pipeQueue is not empty
Post-condition: The queue is unchanged.

PipeQueue::undo
Summary: Restores a pipe to the front of the queue (for undo operations).
Algorithm: Insert the given pipe at position 0 of the pipeQueue list.
Related Features: pipeQueue field
Related Classes: Pipe
Input: pipe : Pipe - the pipe to restore
Output: void
Pre-condition: pipe is not null
Post-condition: The pipe is inserted at the front of the queue.

PipeQueue::consume
Summary: Removes and discards the pipe at the front of the queue, then refills the queue if needed.
Algorithm:
  1. Remove the first element from pipeQueue list.
  2. While pipeQueue.size() < maxGenLength, call generateNewPipe() and add the result to the end.
Related Features: pipeQueue, maxGenLength fields
Related Classes: Pipe
Input: None
Output: void
Pre-condition: pipeQueue is not empty
Post-condition: The front pipe is removed, and the queue is refilled to maxGenLength with random pipes.

PipeQueue::generateNewPipe
Summary: Creates a new pipe with a randomly selected shape.
Algorithm:
  1. Randomly select a PipeShape value from all available shapes (HORIZONTAL, VERTICAL, TOP_LEFT, TOP_RIGHT, BOTTOM_LEFT, BOTTOM_RIGHT, CROSS).
  2. Create a new Pipe with that shape and filled=false.
  3. Return the new pipe.
Related Features: None
Related Classes: Pipe, PipeShape
Input: None
Output: Pipe - a new randomly generated pipe
Pre-condition: None
Post-condition: A new pipe with random shape is created (not filled).

# Requirement
```text
Overall / Domain Description
This is a console pipe-connection game. The game board is a grid surrounded by outer walls. Inside the board there is one source, and on the border there is one sink. The player places pipes from a pipe queue. After an initial delay, water begins to flow through connected pipes.
The board uses zero-based internal array indices. However, index 0 and the last row/column are occupied by the outer wall border. Therefore, the playable area starts from internal index 1 and ends at rows - 2 / cols - 2.
Player-facing coordinates intentionally align with these playable internal indices:
row 1 refers to internal row 1, and column 'A' refers to internal column 1. No row-minus-one or column-minus-one conversion is applied, except that column letters are mapped so that 'A' becomes 1.
Directions include up, down, left, and right. Each direction has a corresponding opposite direction and a unit movement offset(class PA19Helper will help class Direction to provide these functions). Pipe shapes define which directions they connect to. Termination type distinguishes source and sink.

Functional Requirements

Coordinate and Direction
A coordinate stores the internal row and column used directly to access the cell grid. A cell stored at a given grid position should carry the same coordinate value.
Because the outer border occupies index 0, playable cells naturally begin at index 1. This allows user input to align directly with the playable internal grid.
Directions support movement calculations through their unit offsets and can be compared against their opposite direction when checking pipe connectivity.

Game
The game supports placing the current pipe, skipping the current pipe, undoing the latest placement, advancing the water state, checking whether the player has won, checking whether the player has lost, and tracking the number of player steps.
When the player places a pipe, the row value is used directly. The column letter is converted so that 'A' maps to column 1, 'B' maps to column 2, and so on. For example, row 1 and column 'A' target the internal cell at [1][1].
Skipping removes the current pipe from the front of the queue and counts as one step.
Undo restores the latest placed pipe to the front of the queue, clears that pipe from the board, and counts as one step. If there is no previous placement to undo, the operation fails without changing the board.

Map
The map stores cells in a two-dimensional grid with indices from [0..rows-1] and [0..cols-1]. The outermost row and column positions are walls. The playable area is [1..rows-2] by [1..cols-2].
A pipe may be placed only when all of the following are true:
1. The target coordinate is inside the playable area.
2. The target cell is a fillable cell.
3. The target cell does not already contain a pipe.

Cell Family
Cells are parsed from map characters into concrete cell types.
A fillable cell may contain a pipe or be empty. Empty fillable cells render as a dot.
A termination cell represents either the source or the sink. It stores the direction it points toward and whether it has been filled by water.
A wall cell represents the board boundary and renders using the wall character.

Termination Cell Rendering
A termination cell renders as an arrow based on its direction and filled state. Filled and unfilled arrows come from the shared rendering constants.
Both source and sink use their stored pointing direction directly. The direction is not reversed for either type.
Throws IllegalStateException("Invalid pointingTo value!") for unknown direction.

Pipe
A pipe has a shape and a filled state. Its shape determines the directions it connects to.
Supported pipe shapes include horizontal, vertical, the four corner shapes, and cross.
Pipe rendering depends on both shape and filled state. The rendered character should come from the shared rendering constants rather than hardcoded glyphs.
Short pipe codes include HZ, VT, TL, TR, BL, BR, and CR.

Water Flow
At the beginning of water flow, the source is marked as filled.
Water expands outward from the source by distance. Each update increases the reachable fill distance by one.
Water may move from one pipe to an adjacent pipe only when both sides connect to each other: the outgoing direction of one pipe must match the opposite direction of the neighboring pipe.
The filling process follows breadth-first expansion from the source.

Win and Loss Conditions
The player wins if there is a connected path from the source to the sink.
Path checking starts from the source by moving once in the source’s pointing direction. From each pipe, traversal continues through that pipe’s connection directions. The path does not require pipes to already be filled. Reaching the sink means the game is won.
The player loses when a water-flow update fills no new pipes. Loss is checked only after the initial delay has ended and water has actually started advancing.

Pipe Queue
The pipe queue stores upcoming pipes. The player always interacts with the pipe at the front.
When a pipe is consumed, the queue is automatically refilled up to a fixed maximum length using randomly generated pipe shapes.
Undo places the restored pipe back at the front of the queue.

Delay Bar
The delay bar starts with an initial value and decreases once per round.
While the value is still positive, water has not begun flowing. Once the countdown passes zero, the corresponding positive distance indicates how far water should expand from the source.

Cell Stack
The placement history records successfully placed cells in order.
Undo uses the most recent placement. The undo counter represents the number of successful undo actions, not the current size of the placement history.

External / Tool Classes
Pa19Helper is a handwritten helper and assembly class in the pa19 package. It is responsible for constructing core game objects from provided inputs, wiring together the map, pipe queue, delay bar, and placement history. It also centralizes basic parsing and direction utility behavior.
Deserializer is responsible for reading game input from a file and producing runtime game objects. It validates that the input file exists, reads the board size, delay value, map lines, and optional default pipes. If the input ends unexpectedly or an I/O error occurs, it returns no game object and logs the error.
When parsing map text, border cells are treated as sink-side termination candidates, while inner termination symbols are treated as source-side candidates.
Deserializer ignores blank lines and comment lines beginning with # when reading meaningful input.
PipePatterns is a final utility-style constant holder for all rendering characters. It contains the wall character and grouped constants for filled and unfilled arrows and pipe shapes. Rendering logic should rely on these constants instead of hardcoded characters.
StringUtils is a lightweight utility-style class for string helpers and should not be instantiated.
```

public boolean tryPlacePipe(final int row, final int col, final Pipe pipe)
{
    // Validate coordinate is within playable area [1..rows-2] x [1..cols-2]
    if (row < 1 || row > getRows() - 2 || col < 1 || col > getCols() - 2) {
        return false;
    }
    // Get the cell at the coordinate
    Cell targetCell = getCell()[row][col];
    // If the cell is a FillableCell and has no pipe (pipe == null), set the cell's pipe to the given pipe and return true
    if (targetCell instanceof FillableCell) {
        FillableCell fillableCell = (FillableCell) targetCell;
        if (fillableCell.getPipe() == null) {
            fillableCell.setPipe(pipe);
            return true;
        }
    }
    // Otherwise return false
    return false;
}

public void fillTiles(final int distance)
{
    // 1. If this is the first fill, call fillBeginTile()
    if (getPrevFilledDistance() == null || getPrevFilledDistance() == 0) {
        fillBeginTile();
    }
    
    // Store the current filledTiles size before this fill operation
    setPrevFilledTiles(getFilledTiles().size());
    
    // BFS setup
    TerminationCell source = getSourceCell();
    Coordinate sourceCoord = source.getCoord();
    Direction pointingTo = source.getPointingTo();
    
    // Get the starting cell adjacent to source in the pointingTo direction
    int startRow = sourceCoord.getRow() + (pointingTo == Direction.UP ? -1 : pointingTo == Direction.DOWN ? 1 : 0);
    int startCol = sourceCoord.getCol() + (pointingTo == Direction.LEFT ? -1 : pointingTo == Direction.RIGHT ? 1 : 0);
    
    // BFS queue - store as array of [row, col, dist]
    java.util.Queue<int[]> queue = new java.util.LinkedList<>();
    boolean[][] visited = new boolean[getRows()][getCols()];
    
    if (startRow >= 0 && startRow < getRows() && startCol >= 0 && startCol < getCols()) {
        queue.add(new int[]{startRow, startCol, 1});
        visited[startRow][startCol] = true;
    }
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
        int[] current = queue.poll();
        int r = current[0];
        int c = current[1];
        int dist = current[2];
        
        if (dist > distance) {
            continue;
        }
        
        Cell cell = getCell()[r][c];
        
        if (cell instanceof FillableCell) {
            FillableCell fc = (FillableCell) cell;
            Pipe pipe = fc.getPipe();
            if (pipe != null && !pipe.isFilled()) {
                // Mark as filled
                pipe.setFilled(true);
                getFilledTiles().add(fc.getCoord());
                
                // Explore connections
                for (Direction dir : pipe.getConnections()) {
                    int nr = r + (dir == Direction.UP ? -1 : dir == Direction.DOWN ? 1 : 0);
                    int nc = c + (dir == Direction.LEFT ? -1 : dir == Direction.RIGHT ? 1 : 0);
                    
                    if (nr >= 0 && nr < getRows() && nc >= 0 && nc < getCols() && !visited[nr][nc]) {
                        visited[nr][nc] = true;
                        Cell neighbor = getCell()[nr][nc];
                        
                        if (neighbor instanceof FillableCell) {
                            Pipe neighborPipe = ((FillableCell) neighbor).getPipe();
                            if (neighborPipe != null && !neighborPipe.isFilled()) {
                                // Check if neighbor pipe has connection in opposite direction
                                Direction opposite = getOpposite(dir);
                                if (neighborPipe.getConnections().contains(opposite)) {
                                    queue.add(new int[]{nr, nc, dist + 1});
                                }
                            }
                        } else if (neighbor instanceof TerminationCell) {
                            TerminationCell tc = (TerminationCell) neighbor;
                            if (!tc.isFilled() && tc.getPointingTo() == getOpposite(dir)) {
                                tc.setFilled(true);
                                getFilledTiles().add(tc.getCoord());
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        } else if (cell instanceof TerminationCell) {
            TerminationCell tc = (TerminationCell) cell;
            if (!tc.isFilled() && tc.getType() == TerminationType.SINK) {
                // Check if water can enter the sink
                // The sink has a pointingTo direction; water must come from the opposite direction
                // Actually, the sink's pointingTo indicates which direction it points to
                // Water enters from the opposite direction
                tc.setFilled(true);
                getFilledTiles().add(tc.getCoord());
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Update prevFilledDistance
    setPrevFilledDistance(distance);
}
public boolean hasLost()
{
    // 1. If prevFilledDistance is null or 0, return false
    if (getPrevFilledDistance() == null || getPrevFilledDistance() == 0) {
        return false;
    }
    // 2. Compare current filledTiles size with prevFilledTiles
    return getFilledTiles().size() == getPrevFilledTiles();
}

## EMF Coding Style
- When possible, call getter/setter methods to access field values. Do not read/write raw fields derived from the class diagram.
- The getter of a boolean attribute `bv` looks like `isBv()`, e.g., `isIsTrue()` for `isTrue`.
- When possibe, use the creation factory for object creation.
- To create an EList instance, import and use `org.eclipse.emf.common.util.BasicEList`.

## EMF Coding Style
- When possible, call getter/setter methods to access field values. Do not read/write raw fields derived from the class diagram.
- The getter of a boolean attribute `bv` looks like `isBv()`, e.g., `isIsTrue()` for `isTrue`.
- When possibe, use the creation factory for object creation.
- To create an EList instance, import and use `org.eclipse.emf.common.util.BasicEList`.

## EMF Coding Style
- When possible, call getter/setter methods to access field values. Do not read/write raw fields derived from the class diagram.
- The getter of a boolean attribute `bv` looks like `isBv()`, e.g., `isIsTrue()` for `isTrue`.
- When possibe, use the creation factory for object creation.
- To create an EList instance, import and use `org.eclipse.emf.common.util.BasicEList`.

For the `tryPlacePipe(final int row, final int col, final Pipe pipe)` method:
1. Validate coordinate is within playable area [1..rows-2] x [1..cols-2]
2. Get the cell at the coordinate
3. If the cell is a FillableCell and has no pipe (pipe == null), set the cell's pipe to the given pipe and return true
4. Otherwise return false

For the `undo(final Coordinate coord)` method:
1. Get the cell at the given coordinate
2. If the cell is a FillableCell, set its pipe to null

For the `fillTiles(final int distance)` method:
1. If this is the first fill (prevFilledDistance is null or 0), call fillBeginTile() to mark source as filled
2. Perform BFS from source, expanding outward up to the given distance
3. For each pipe encountered, check connectivity
4. Mark reachable pipes as filled
5. Update filledTiles list with newly filled coordinates
6. Set prevFilledTiles to the size of filledTiles before this fill operation
7. Update prevFilledDistance to current distance

For the `hasLost()` method:
1. If prevFilledDistance is null or 0, return false
2. Compare current filledTiles size with prevFilledTiles. If they are equal, return true. Otherwise return false.

   * Algorithm:
   *   1. If this is the first fill (prevFilledDistance is null or 0), call fillBeginTile() to mark source as filled.
   *   2. Perform BFS from source, expanding outward up to the given distance.
   *   3. For each pipe encountered, check connectivity: water can move from pipe A to pipe B if A has a connection direction d and B has a connection in the opposite direction of d.
   *   4. Mark reachable pipes as filled.
   *   5. Update filledTiles list with newly filled coordinates.
   *   6. Set prevFilledTiles to the size of filledTiles before this fill operation.
   *   7. Update prevFilledDistance to current distance.
   * Related Features: sourceCell, filledTiles, prevFilledDistance, prevFilledTiles fields

   * Input: distance : int - the maximum distance (in steps) from source to fill
   * Output: void
   * Pre-condition: distance >= 0
   * Post-condition: All pipes within the given distance that form a connected path from source are marked as filled.
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT

  public void fillTiles(final int distance)
  {
    if (getPrevFilledDistance() == null || getPrevFilledDistance() == 0) {
      fillBeginTile();
    }
    
    int prevSize = getFilledTiles().size();
    setPrevFilledTiles(prevSize);
    
    Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
    
    // BFS using a queue
    EList<Coordinate> queue = new BasicEList<Coordinate>();
    EList<Coordinate> visited = new BasicEList<Coordinate>();
    
    Coordinate sourceCoord = getSourceCell().getCoord();
    queue.add(sourceCoord);
    visited.add(sourceCoord);
    
    int currentDistance = 0;
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty() && currentDistance < distance) {
      int levelSize = queue.size();
      for (int i = 0; i < levelSize; i++) {
        Coordinate current = queue.get(0);
        queue.remove(0);
        
        Cell currentCell = getCell()[current.getRow()][current.getCol()];
        
        // If it's a FillableCell with a pipe
        if (currentCell instanceof FillableCell) {
          FillableCell fillableCell = (FillableCell) currentCell;
          Pipe currentPipe = fillableCell.getPipe();
          if (currentPipe != null) {
            currentPipe.setFilled(true);
            if (!getFilledTiles().contains(current)) {
              getFilledTiles().add(current);
            }
            
            // Check each connection direction
            for (Direction dir : currentPipe.getConnections()) {
              Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
              Coordinate neighborCoord = current.add(offset);
              int nr = neighborCoord.getRow();
              int nc = neighborCoord.getCol();
              
              if (nr >= 0 && nr < getRows() && nc >= 0 && nc < getCols() && !visited.contains(neighborCoord)) {
                Cell neighborCell = getCell()[nr][nc];
                if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                  FillableCell neighborFillable = (FillableCell) neighborCell;
                  Pipe neighborPipe = neighborFillable.getPipe();
                  if (neighborPipe != null) {
                    Direction opposite = helper.getOpposite(dir);
                    if (neighborPipe.getConnections().contains(opposite)) {
                      visited.add(neighborCoord);
                      queue.add(neighborCoord);
                    }
                  }
                } else if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                  TerminationCell termCell = (TerminationCell) neighborCell;
                  Direction opposite = helper.getOpposite(dir);
                  if (termCell.getPointingTo() == opposite) {
                    visited.add(neighborCoord);
                    queue.add(neighborCoord);
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          }
        } else if (currentCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
          TerminationCell termCell = (TerminationCell) currentCell;
          if (termCell.isFilled()) {
            // Check the direction the termination cell points to
            Direction dir = termCell.getPointingTo();
            Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
            Coordinate neighborCoord = current.add(offset);
            int nr = neighborCoord.getRow();
            int nc = neighborCoord.getCol();
            
            if (nr >= 0 && nr < getRows() && nc >= 0 && nc < getCols() && !visited.contains(neighborCoord)) {
              Cell neighborCell = getCell()[nr][nc];
              if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                FillableCell neighborFillable = (FillableCell) neighborCell;
                Pipe neighborPipe = neighborFillable.getPipe();
                if (neighborPipe != null) {
                  Direction opposite = helper.getOpposite(dir);
                  if (neighborPipe.getConnections().contains(opposite)) {
                    visited.add(neighborCoord);
                    queue.add(neighborCoord);
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
      currentDistance++;
    }
    
    // Process remaining items in the queue at the current distance level
    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
      Coordinate current = queue.get(0);
      queue.remove(0);
      
      Cell currentCell = getCell()[current.getRow()][current.getCol()];
      
      if (currentCell instanceof FillableCell) {
        FillableCell fillableCell = (FillableCell) currentCell;
        Pipe currentPipe = fillableCell.getPipe();
        if (currentPipe != null) {
          currentPipe.setFilled(true);
          if (!getFilledTiles().contains(current)) {

          }

        if (!termCell.isFilled()) {
          termCell.setFilled(true);
        }
        if (!getFilledTiles().contains(current)) {

        }

    }

public void fillTiles(final int distance) {
    // Step 1: If first fill, call fillBeginTile()
    if (getPrevFilledDistance() == null || getPrevFilledDistance() == 0) {
      fillBeginTile();
    }
    
    // Step 6: Record prevFilledTiles before this fill operation
    setPrevFilledTiles(getFilledTiles().size());
    
    Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
    
    // BFS
    EList<Coordinate> queue = new BasicEList<Coordinate>();
    EList<Coordinate> visited = new BasicEList<Coordinate>();
    
    // Start from source
    Coordinate sourceCoord = getSourceCell().getCoord();
    queue.add(sourceCoord);
    visited.add(sourceCoord);
    
    int currentDist = 0;
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty() && currentDist < distance) {
      int levelSize = queue.size();
      for (int i = 0; i < levelSize; i++) {
        Coordinate current = queue.remove(0);
        Cell cell = getCell()[current.getRow()][current.getCol()];
        
        // Mark current cell as filled
        if (cell instanceof FillableCell) {
          FillableCell fc = (FillableCell) cell;
          Pipe pipe = fc.getPipe();
          if (pipe != null) {
            pipe.setFilled(true);
            if (!getFilledTiles().contains(current)) {
              getFilledTiles().add(current);
            }
            
            // Expand through pipe connections
            for (Direction dir : pipe.getConnections()) {
              Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
              Coordinate neighbor = current.add(offset);
              int nr = neighbor.getRow();
              int nc = neighbor.getCol();
              
              if (nr >= 0 && nr < getRows() && nc >= 0 && nc < getCols() && !visited.contains(neighbor)) {
                Cell neighborCell = getCell()[nr][nc];
                if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                  FillableCell nfc = (FillableCell) neighborCell;
                  Pipe np = nfc.getPipe();
                  if (np != null) {
                    Direction opposite = helper.getOpposite(dir);
                    if (np.getConnections().contains(opposite)) {
                      visited.add(neighbor);
                      queue.add(neighbor);
                    }
                  }

                  TerminationCell tc = (TerminationCell) neighborCell;
                  Direction opposite = helper.getOpposite(dir);
                  if (tc.getPointingTo() == opposite) {

                    queue.add(neighbor);

                  queue.add(neighbor);

For the `tryPlacePipe(final int row, final int col, final Pipe pipe)` method:

For the `fillTiles(final int distance)` method:

2. Perform BFS from source, expanding outward up to the given distance
3. For each pipe encountered, check connectivity
4. Mark reachable pipes as filled
5. Update filledTiles list with newly filled coordinates
6. Set prevFilledTiles to the size of filledTiles before this fill operation
7. Update prevFilledDistance to current distance

For the `hasLost()` method:
1. If prevFilledDistance is null or 0, return false
2. Compare current filledTiles size with prevFilledTiles. If they are equal, return true. Otherwise return false.

   * Summary: Attempts to place a pipe at the specified coordinate on the map.

   *   1. Validate coordinate is within playable area [1..rows-2] x [1..cols-2].
   *   2. Get the cell at the coordinate.

   *   4. Otherwise return false.
   * Related Features: cell array, rows, cols fields
   * Related Classes: Coordinate, FillableCell, Pipe
   * Input: row : int - internal grid row, col : int - internal grid column, pipe : Pipe - the pipe to place
   * Output: boolean - true if placement succeeded, false otherwise

   * Post-condition: If successful, the cell at (row, col) now contains the given pipe. Otherwise no change.
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->

  public boolean tryPlacePipe(final int row, final int col, final Pipe pipe)
  {
    if (row < 1 || row > getRows() - 2 || col < 1 || col > getCols() - 2) {
      return false;
    }
    Cell targetCell = getCell()[row][col];
    if (targetCell instanceof FillableCell) {
      FillableCell fillableCell = (FillableCell) targetCell;
      if (fillableCell.getPipe() == null) {
        fillableCell.setPipe(pipe);
        return true;
      }
    }
    return false;
  }

  {
    if (getPrevFilledDistance() == null || getPrevFilledDistance() == 0) {
      fillBeginTile();
    }

    setPrevFilledTiles(prevSize);
    
    Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
    
    // BFS using a queue
    EList<Coordinate> queue = new BasicEList<Coordinate>();
    EList<Coordinate> visited = new BasicEList<Coordinate>();
    
    Coordinate sourceCoord = getSourceCell().getCoord();
    queue.add(sourceCoord);
    visited.add(sourceCoord);
    
    int currentDistance = 0;
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty() && currentDistance < distance) {
      int levelSize = queue.size();
      for (int i = 0; i < levelSize; i++) {
        Coordinate current = queue.get(0);
        queue.remove(0);
        
        Cell currentCell = getCell()[current.getRow()][current.getCol()];
        
        // If it's a FillableCell with a pipe
        if (currentCell instanceof FillableCell) {
          FillableCell fillableCell = (FillableCell) currentCell;
          Pipe currentPipe = fillableCell.getPipe();
          if (currentPipe != null) {
            currentPipe.setFilled(true);
            if (!getFilledTiles().contains(current)) {
              getFilledTiles().add(current);
            }
            
            // Check each connection direction
            for (Direction dir : currentPipe.getConnections()) {
              Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
              Coordinate neighborCoord = current.add(offset);
              int nr = neighborCoord.getRow();
              int nc = neighborCoord.getCol();
              
              if (nr >= 0 && nr < getRows() && nc >= 0 && nc < getCols() && !visited.contains(neighborCoord)) {
                Cell neighborCell = getCell()[nr][nc];
                if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                  FillableCell neighborFillable = (FillableCell) neighborCell;
                  Pipe neighborPipe = neighborFillable.getPipe();
                  if (neighborPipe != null) {
                    Direction opposite = helper.getOpposite(dir);
                    if (neighborPipe.getConnections().contains(opposite)) {
                      visited.add(neighborCoord);
                      queue.add(neighborCoord);
                    }
                  }
                } else if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                  TerminationCell termCell = (TerminationCell) neighborCell;
                  Direction opposite = helper.getOpposite(dir);
                  if (termCell.getPointingTo() == opposite) {
                    visited.add(neighborCoord);
                    queue.add(neighborCoord);
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          }
        } else if (currentCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
          TerminationCell termCell = (TerminationCell) currentCell;
          if (termCell.isFilled()) {
            // Check the direction the termination cell points to
            Direction dir = termCell.getPointingTo();
            Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
            Coordinate neighborCoord = current.add(offset);
            int nr = neighborCoord.getRow();
            int nc = neighborCoord.getCol();

                Pipe neighborPipe = neighborFillable.getPipe();
                if (neighborPipe != null) {
                  Direction opposite = helper.getOpposite(dir);
                  if (neighborPipe.getConnections().contains(opposite)) {
                    visited.add(neighborCoord);
                    queue.add(neighborCoord);
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
      currentDistance++;
    }
    
    // Process remaining items in the queue at the current distance level
    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
      Coordinate current = queue.get(0);
      queue.remove(0);
      
      Cell currentCell = getCell()[current.getRow()][current.getCol()];

   * Summary: Fills tiles with water up to the given distance from the source using BFS.

   *   1. If this is the first fill (prevFilledDistance is null or 0), call fillBeginTile() to mark source as filled.
   *   2. Perform BFS from source, expanding outward up to the given distance.
   *   3. For each pipe encountered, check connectivity: water can move from pipe A to pipe B if A has a connection direction d and B has a connection in the opposite direction of d.

    queue.add(sourceCoord);

    int currentDist = 0;

      int levelSize = queue.size();
      for (int i = 0; i < levelSize; i++) {

## EMF Coding Style
- When possible, call getter/setter methods to access field values. Do not read/write raw fields derived from the class diagram.
- The getter of a boolean attribute `bv` looks like `isBv()`, e.g., `isIsTrue()` for `isTrue`.
- When possibe, use the creation factory for object creation.
- To create an EList instance, import and use `org.eclipse.emf.common.util.BasicEList`.

   * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
   * Summary: Fills tiles with water up to the given distance from the source using BFS.
   * Algorithm:
   *   1. If this is the first fill (prevFilledDistance is null or 0), call fillBeginTile() to mark source as filled.
   *   2. Perform BFS from source, expanding outward up to the given distance.
   *   3. For each pipe encountered, check connectivity: water can move from pipe A to pipe B if A has a connection direction d and B has a connection in the opposite direction of d.
   *   4. Mark reachable pipes as filled.
   *   5. Update filledTiles list with newly filled coordinates.
   *   6. Set prevFilledTiles to the size of filledTiles before this fill operation.
   *   7. Update prevFilledDistance to current distance.
   * Related Features: sourceCell, filledTiles, prevFilledDistance, prevFilledTiles fields
   * Related Classes: TerminationCell, FillableCell, Pipe, Coordinate, Direction
   * Input: distance : int - the maximum distance (in steps) from source to fill
   * Output: void
   * Pre-condition: distance >= 0
   * Post-condition: All pipes within the given distance that form a connected path from source are marked as filled.
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT

  public void fillTiles(final int distance)
  {
    if (getPrevFilledDistance() == null || getPrevFilledDistance() == 0) {
      fillBeginTile();
    }
    
    setPrevFilledTiles(getFilledTiles().size());
    
    Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
    
    EList<Coordinate> queue = new BasicEList<Coordinate>();
    EList<Coordinate> visited = new BasicEList<Coordinate>();
    
    Coordinate sourceCoord = getSourceCell().getCoord();
    queue.add(sourceCoord);
    visited.add(sourceCoord);
    
    int currentDist = 0;
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty() && currentDist < distance) {
      int levelSize = queue.size();
      for (int i = 0; i < levelSize; i++) {
        Coordinate current = queue.remove(0);
        Cell cell = getCell()[current.getRow()][current.getCol()];
        
        if (cell instanceof FillableCell) {
          FillableCell fillableCell = (FillableCell) cell;
          Pipe pipe = fillableCell.getPipe();
          if (pipe != null) {
            pipe.setFilled(true);
            if (!getFilledTiles().contains(current)) {
              getFilledTiles().add(current);
            }
            
            for (Direction dir : pipe.getConnections()) {
              Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
              Coordinate neighborCoord = current.add(offset);
              int nr = neighborCoord.getRow();
              int nc = neighborCoord.getCol();
              
              if (nr >= 0 && nr < getRows() && nc >= 0 && nc < getCols() && !visited.contains(neighborCoord)) {
                Cell neighborCell = getCell()[nr][nc];
                Direction opposite = helper.getOpposite(dir);
                
                if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                  FillableCell nfc = (FillableCell) neighborCell;
                  Pipe np = nfc.getPipe();
                  if (np != null && np.getConnections().contains(opposite)) {
                    visited.add(neighborCoord);
                    queue.add(neighborCoord);
                  }
                } else if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                  TerminationCell tc = (TerminationCell) neighborCell;
                  if (tc.getPointingTo() == opposite) {
                    visited.add(neighborCoord);
                    queue.add(neighborCoord);
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          }
        } else if (cell instanceof TerminationCell) {
          TerminationCell termCell = (TerminationCell) cell;
          if (!termCell.isFilled()) {
            termCell.setFilled(true);
          }
          if (!getFilledTiles().contains(current)) {
            getFilledTiles().add(current);
          }
          
          Direction dir = termCell.getPointingTo();
          Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
          Coordinate neighborCoord = current.add(offset);
          int nr = neighborCoord.getRow();
          int nc = neighborCoord.getCol();
          
          if (nr >= 0 && nr < getRows() && nc >= 0 && nc < getCols() && !visited.contains(neighborCoord)) {
            Cell neighborCell = getCell()[nr][nc];
            Direction opposite = helper.getOpposite(dir);

              Pipe np = nfc.getPipe();
              if (np != null && np.getConnections().contains(opposite)) {
                visited.add(neighborCoord);
                queue.add(neighborCoord);
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
      currentDist++;
    }
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
      Coordinate current = queue.remove(0);
      Cell cell = getCell()[current.getRow()][current.getCol()];
      
      if (cell instanceof FillableCell) {
        FillableCell fillableCell = (FillableCell) cell;

            getFilledTiles().add(current);
          }

          termCell.setFilled(true);
        }
        if (!getFilledTiles().contains(current)) {
          getFilledTiles().add(current);
        }
      }
    }

              }

          }
        }
      }

    }

          }

        }

        }

  /**
   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
   * <!-- end-user-doc -->
   * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
   * Summary: Fills tiles with water up to the given distance from the source using BFS.
   * Algorithm:
   *   1. If this is the first fill (prevFilledDistance is null or 0), call fillBeginTile() to mark source as filled.
   *   2. Perform BFS from source, expanding outward up to the given distance.
   *   3. For each pipe encountered, check connectivity: water can move from pipe A to pipe B if A has a connection direction d and B has a connection in the opposite direction of d.
   *   4. Mark reachable pipes as filled.
   *   5. Update filledTiles list with newly filled coordinates.
   *   6. Set prevFilledTiles to the size of filledTiles before this fill operation.
   *   7. Update prevFilledDistance to current distance.
   * Related Features: sourceCell, filledTiles, prevFilledDistance, prevFilledTiles fields
   * Related Classes: TerminationCell, FillableCell, Pipe, Coordinate, Direction
   * Input: distance : int - the maximum distance (in steps) from source to fill
   * Output: void
   * Pre-condition: distance >= 0
   * Post-condition: All pipes within the given distance that form a connected path from source are marked as filled.
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT
   */
  public void fillTiles(final int distance)
  {
    if (getPrevFilledDistance() == null || getPrevFilledDistance() == 0) {
      fillBeginTile();
    }
    
    setPrevFilledTiles(getFilledTiles().size());
    
    Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
    
    EList<Coordinate> queue = new BasicEList<Coordinate>();
    EList<Coordinate> visited = new BasicEList<Coordinate>();
    
    Coordinate sourceCoord = getSourceCell().getCoord();
    queue.add(sourceCoord);
    visited.add(sourceCoord);
    
    int currentDist = 0;
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty() && currentDist < distance) {
      int levelSize = queue.size();
      for (int i = 0; i < levelSize; i++) {
        Coordinate current = queue.remove(0);
        Cell cell = getCell()[current.getRow()][current.getCol()];
        
        if (cell instanceof FillableCell) {
          FillableCell fillableCell = (FillableCell) cell;
          Pipe pipe = fillableCell.getPipe();
          if (pipe != null) {
            pipe.setFilled(true);
            if (!getFilledTiles().contains(current)) {
              getFilledTiles().add(current);
            }
            
            for (Direction dir : pipe.getConnections()) {
              Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
              Coordinate neighborCoord = current.add(offset);
              int nr = neighborCoord.getRow();
              int nc = neighborCoord.getCol();
              
              if (nr >= 0 && nr < getRows() && nc >= 0 && nc < getCols() && !visited.contains(neighborCoord)) {
                Cell neighborCell = getCell()[nr][nc];
                Direction opposite = helper.getOpposite(dir);
                
                if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                  FillableCell nfc = (FillableCell) neighborCell;
                  Pipe np = nfc.getPipe();
                  if (np != null && np.getConnections().contains(opposite)) {
                    visited.add(neighborCoord);
                    queue.add(neighborCoord);
                  }
                } else if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                  TerminationCell tc = (TerminationCell) neighborCell;
                  if (tc.getPointingTo() == opposite) {
                    visited.add(neighborCoord);
                    queue.add(neighborCoord);
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          }
        } else if (cell instanceof TerminationCell) {
          TerminationCell termCell = (TerminationCell) cell;
          if (!termCell.isFilled()) {
            termCell.setFilled(true);
          }
          if (!getFilledTiles().contains(current)) {
            getFilledTiles().add(current);
          }
          
          Direction dir = termCell.getPointingTo();
          Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
          Coordinate neighborCoord = current.add(offset);
          int nr = neighborCoord.getRow();
          int nc = neighborCoord.getCol();
          
          if (nr >= 0 && nr < getRows() && nc >= 0 && nc < getCols() && !visited.contains(neighborCoord)) {
            Cell neighborCell = getCell()[nr][nc];
            Direction opposite = helper.getOpposite(dir);
            
            if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
              FillableCell nfc = (FillableCell) neighborCell;
              Pipe np = nfc.getPipe();
              if (np != null && np.getConnections().contains(opposite)) {
                visited.add(neighborCoord);
                queue.add(neighborCoord);
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
      currentDist++;
    }
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
      Coordinate current = queue.remove(0);
      Cell cell = getCell()[current.getRow()][current.getCol()];
      
      if (cell instanceof FillableCell) {
        FillableCell fillableCell = (FillableCell) cell;
        Pipe pipe = fillableCell.getPipe();
        if (pipe != null) {
          pipe.setFilled(true);
          if (!getFilledTiles().contains(current)) {
            getFilledTiles().add(current);
          }
        }
      } else if (cell instanceof TerminationCell) {
        TerminationCell termCell = (TerminationCell) cell;
        if (!termCell.isFilled()) {
          termCell.setFilled(true);
        }
        if (!getFilledTiles().contains(current)) {
          getFilledTiles().add(current);
        }
      }
    }
    
    setPrevFilledDistance(distance);
  }

  public void fillTiles(final int distance)

      fillBeginTile();
    }
    
    setPrevFilledTiles(getFilledTiles().size());
    
    Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
    
    EList<Coordinate> queue = new BasicEList<Coordinate>();
    EList<Coordinate> visited = new BasicEList<Coordinate>();
    
    Coordinate sourceCoord = getSourceCell().getCoord();
    queue.add(sourceCoord);
    visited.add(sourceCoord);
    
    int currentDist = 0;
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty() && currentDist < distance) {
      int levelSize = queue.size();
      for (int i = 0; i < levelSize; i++) {
        Coordinate current = queue.remove(0);
        Cell cell = getCell()[current.getRow()][current.getCol()];
        
        if (cell instanceof FillableCell) {
          FillableCell fillableCell = (FillableCell) cell;
          Pipe pipe = fillableCell.getPipe();
          if (pipe != null) {
            pipe.setFilled(true);
            if (!getFilledTiles().contains(current)) {
              getFilledTiles().add(current);
            }
            
            for (Direction dir : pipe.getConnections()) {
              Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
              Coordinate neighborCoord = current.add(offset);
              int nr = neighborCoord.getRow();
              int nc = neighborCoord.getCol();
              
              if (nr >= 0 && nr < getRows() && nc >= 0 && nc < getCols() && !visited.contains(neighborCoord)) {
                Cell neighborCell = getCell()[nr][nc];
                Direction opposite = helper.getOpposite(dir);
                
                if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                  FillableCell nfc = (FillableCell) neighborCell;
                  Pipe np = nfc.getPipe();
                  if (np != null && np.getConnections().contains(opposite)) {
                    visited.add(neighborCoord);
                    queue.add(neighborCoord);
                  }
                } else if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                  TerminationCell tc = (TerminationCell) neighborCell;
                  if (tc.getPointingTo() == opposite) {
                    visited.add(neighborCoord);
                    queue.add(neighborCoord);
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          }
        } else if (cell instanceof TerminationCell) {
          TerminationCell termCell = (TerminationCell) cell;
          if (!termCell.isFilled()) {
            termCell.setFilled(true);
          }
          if (!getFilledTiles().contains(current)) {
            getFilledTiles().add(current);
          }
          
          Direction dir = termCell.getPointingTo();
          Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
          Coordinate neighborCoord = current.add(offset);
          int nr = neighborCoord.getRow();
          int nc = neighborCoord.getCol();
          
          if (nr >= 0 && nr < getRows() && nc >= 0 && nc < getCols() && !visited.contains(neighborCoord)) {
            Cell neighborCell = getCell()[nr][nc];
            Direction opposite = helper.getOpposite(dir);

              FillableCell nfc = (FillableCell) neighborCell;
              Pipe np = nfc.getPipe();
              if (np != null && np.getConnections().contains(opposite)) {
                visited.add(neighborCoord);
                queue.add(neighborCoord);
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
      currentDist++;
    }
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
      Coordinate current = queue.remove(0);
      Cell cell = getCell()[current.getRow()][current.getCol()];
      
      if (cell instanceof FillableCell) {
        FillableCell fillableCell = (FillableCell) cell;
        Pipe pipe = fillableCell.getPipe();
        if (pipe != null) {
          pipe.setFilled(true);
          if (!getFilledTiles().contains(current)) {
            getFilledTiles().add(current);
          }
        }

        if (!termCell.isFilled()) {
          termCell.setFilled(true);
        }
        if (!getFilledTiles().contains(current)) {
          getFilledTiles().add(current);
        }

  /**
   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
   * <!-- end-user-doc -->
   * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
   * Summary: Fills tiles with water up to the given distance from the source using BFS.
   * Algorithm:
   *   1. If this is the first fill (prevFilledDistance is null or 0), call fillBeginTile() to mark source as filled.
   *   2. Perform BFS from source, expanding outward up to the given distance.
   *   3. For each pipe encountered, check connectivity: water can move from pipe A to pipe B if A has a connection direction d and B has a connection in the opposite direction of d.
   *   4. Mark reachable pipes as filled.
   *   5. Update filledTiles list with newly filled coordinates.
   *   6. Set prevFilledTiles to the size of filledTiles before this fill operation.
   *   7. Update prevFilledDistance to current distance.
   * Related Features: sourceCell, filledTiles, prevFilledDistance, prevFilledTiles fields
   * Related Classes: TerminationCell, FillableCell, Pipe, Coordinate, Direction
   * Input: distance : int - the maximum distance (in steps) from source to fill
   * Output: void
   * Pre-condition: distance >= 0
   * Post-condition: All pipes within the given distance that form a connected path from source are marked as filled.
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT
   */
  public void fillTiles(final int distance)
  {
    if (getPrevFilledDistance() == null || getPrevFilledDistance() == 0) {
      fillBeginTile();
    }
    
    setPrevFilledTiles(getFilledTiles().size());
    
    Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
    
    EList<Coordinate> queue = new BasicEList<Coordinate>();
    EList<Coordinate> visited = new BasicEList<Coordinate>();
    
    Coordinate sourceCoord = getSourceCell().getCoord();
    queue.add(sourceCoord);
    visited.add(sourceCoord);
    
    int currentDist = 0;
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty() && currentDist < distance) {
      int levelSize = queue.size();
      for (int i = 0; i < levelSize; i++) {
        Coordinate current = queue.remove(0);
        Cell cell = getCell()[current.getRow()][current.getCol()];
        
        if (cell instanceof FillableCell) {
          FillableCell fillableCell = (FillableCell) cell;
          Pipe pipe = fillableCell.getPipe();
          if (pipe != null) {
            pipe.setFilled(true);
            if (!getFilledTiles().contains(current)) {
              getFilledTiles().add(current);
            }
            
            for (Direction dir : pipe.getConnections()) {
              Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
              Coordinate neighborCoord = current.add(offset);
              int nr = neighborCoord.getRow();
              int nc = neighborCoord.getCol();
              
              if (nr >= 0 && nr < getRows() && nc >= 0 && nc < getCols() && !visited.contains(neighborCoord)) {
                Cell neighborCell = getCell()[nr][nc];
                Direction opposite = helper.getOpposite(dir);
                
                if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                  FillableCell nfc = (FillableCell) neighborCell;
                  Pipe np = nfc.getPipe();
                  if (np != null && np.getConnections().contains(opposite)) {
                    visited.add(neighborCoord);
                    queue.add(neighborCoord);
                  }
                } else if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                  TerminationCell tc = (TerminationCell) neighborCell;
                  if (tc.getPointingTo() == opposite) {
                    visited.add(neighborCoord);
                    queue.add(neighborCoord);
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          }
        } else if (cell instanceof TerminationCell) {
          TerminationCell termCell = (TerminationCell) cell;
          if (!termCell.isFilled()) {
            termCell.setFilled(true);
          }
          if (!getFilledTiles().contains(current)) {
            getFilledTiles().add(current);
          }
          
          Direction dir = termCell.getPointingTo();
          Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
          Coordinate neighborCoord = current.add(offset);
          int nr = neighborCoord.getRow();
          int nc = neighborCoord.getCol();
          
          if (nr >= 0 && nr < getRows() && nc >= 0 && nc < getCols() && !visited.contains(neighborCoord)) {
            Cell neighborCell = getCell()[nr][nc];
            Direction opposite = helper.getOpposite(dir);
            
            if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
              FillableCell nfc = (FillableCell) neighborCell;
              Pipe np = nfc.getPipe();
              if (np != null && np.getConnections().contains(opposite)) {
                visited.add(neighborCoord);
                queue.add(neighborCoord);
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
      currentDist++;
    }
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
      Coordinate current = queue.remove(0);
      Cell cell = getCell()[current.getRow()][current.getCol()];
      
      if (cell instanceof FillableCell) {
        FillableCell fillableCell = (FillableCell) cell;
        Pipe pipe = fillableCell.getPipe();
        if (pipe != null) {
          pipe.setFilled(true);
          if (!getFilledTiles().contains(current)) {
            getFilledTiles().add(current);
          }
        }
      } else if (cell instanceof TerminationCell) {
        TerminationCell termCell = (TerminationCell) cell;
        if (!termCell.isFilled()) {
          termCell.setFilled(true);
        }
        if (!getFilledTiles().contains(current)) {
          getFilledTiles().add(current);
        }
      }
    }
    
    setPrevFilledDistance(distance);
  }

  /**
   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
   * <!-- end-user-doc -->
   * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
   * Summary: Fills tiles with water up to the given distance from the source using BFS.
   * Algorithm:
   *   1. If this is the first fill (prevFilledDistance is null or 0), call fillBeginTile() to mark source as filled.
   *   2. Perform BFS from source, expanding outward up to the given distance.
   *   3. For each pipe encountered, check connectivity: water can move from pipe A to pipe B if A has a connection direction d and B has a connection in the opposite direction of d.
   *   4. Mark reachable pipes as filled.
   *   5. Update filledTiles list with newly filled coordinates.
   *   6. Set prevFilledTiles to the size of filledTiles before this fill operation.
   *   7. Update prevFilledDistance to current distance.
   * Related Features: sourceCell, filledTiles, prevFilledDistance, prevFilledTiles fields
   * Related Classes: TerminationCell, FillableCell, Pipe, Coordinate, Direction
   * Input: distance : int - the maximum distance (in steps) from source to fill
   * Output: void
   * Pre-condition: distance >= 0
   * Post-condition: All pipes within the given distance that form a connected path from source are marked as filled.
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT
   */
  public void fillTiles(final int distance)
  {
    if (getPrevFilledDistance() == null || getPrevFilledDistance() == 0) {
      fillBeginTile();
    }
    
    setPrevFilledTiles(getFilledTiles().size());
    
    Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
    
    EList<Coordinate> queue = new BasicEList<Coordinate>();
    EList<Coordinate> visited = new BasicEList<Coordinate>();
    
    Coordinate sourceCoord = getSourceCell().getCoord();
    queue.add(sourceCoord);
    visited.add(sourceCoord);
    
    int currentDist = 0;
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty() && currentDist < distance) {
      int levelSize = queue.size();
      for (int i = 0; i < levelSize; i++) {
        Coordinate current = queue.remove(0);
        Cell cell = getCell()[current.getRow()][current.getCol()];
        
        if (cell instanceof FillableCell) {
          FillableCell fillableCell = (FillableCell) cell;
          Pipe pipe = fillableCell.getPipe();
          if (pipe != null) {
            pipe.setFilled(true);
            if (!getFilledTiles().contains(current)) {
              getFilledTiles().add(current);
            }
            
            for (Direction dir : pipe.getConnections()) {
              Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
              Coordinate neighborCoord = current.add(offset);
              int nr = neighborCoord.getRow();
              int nc = neighborCoord.getCol();
              
              if (nr >= 0 && nr < getRows() && nc >= 0 && nc < getCols() && !visited.contains(neighborCoord)) {
                Cell neighborCell = getCell()[nr][nc];
                Direction opposite = helper.getOpposite(dir);
                
                if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                  FillableCell nfc = (FillableCell) neighborCell;
                  Pipe np = nfc.getPipe();
                  if (np != null && np.getConnections().contains(opposite)) {
                    visited.add(neighborCoord);
                    queue.add(neighborCoord);
                  }
                } else if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                  TerminationCell tc = (TerminationCell) neighborCell;
                  if (tc.getPointingTo() == opposite) {
                    visited.add(neighborCoord);
                    queue.add(neighborCoord);
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          }
        } else if (cell instanceof TerminationCell) {
          TerminationCell termCell = (TerminationCell) cell;
          if (!termCell.isFilled()) {
            termCell.setFilled(true);
          }
          if (!getFilledTiles().contains(current)) {
            getFilledTiles().add(current);
          }
          
          Direction dir = termCell.getPointingTo();
          Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
          Coordinate neighborCoord = current.add(offset);
          int nr = neighborCoord.getRow();
          int nc = neighborCoord.getCol();
          
          if (nr >= 0 && nr < getRows() && nc >= 0 && nc < getCols() && !visited.contains(neighborCoord)) {
            Cell neighborCell = getCell()[nr][nc];
            Direction opposite = helper.getOpposite(dir);
            
            if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
              FillableCell nfc = (FillableCell) neighborCell;
              Pipe np = nfc.getPipe();
              if (np != null && np.getConnections().contains(opposite)) {
                visited.add(neighborCoord);
                queue.add(neighborCoord);
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
      currentDist++;
    }
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
      Coordinate current = queue.remove(0);
      Cell cell = getCell()[current.getRow()][current.getCol()];
      
      if (cell instanceof FillableCell) {
        FillableCell fillableCell = (FillableCell) cell;
        Pipe pipe = fillableCell.getPipe();
        if (pipe != null) {
          pipe.setFilled(true);
          if (!getFilledTiles().contains(current)) {
            getFilledTiles().add(current);
          }
        }
      } else if (cell instanceof TerminationCell) {
        TerminationCell termCell = (TerminationCell) cell;
        if (!termCell.isFilled()) {
          termCell.setFilled(true);
        }
        if (!getFilledTiles().contains(current)) {
          getFilledTiles().add(current);
        }
      }
    }
    
    setPrevFilledDistance(distance);
  }

    visited.add(sourceCoord);

      int levelSize = queue.size();
      for (int i = 0; i < levelSize; i++) {

        Cell cell = getCell()[current.getRow()][current.getCol()];

   * Summary: Fills tiles with water up to the given distance from the source using BFS.
   * Algorithm:
   *   1. If this is the first fill (prevFilledDistance is null or 0), call fillBeginTile() to mark source as filled.
   *   2. Perform BFS from source, expanding outward up to the given distance.
   *   3. For each pipe encountered, check connectivity: water can move from pipe A to pipe B if A has a connection direction d and B has a connection in the opposite direction of d.
   *   4. Mark reachable pipes as filled.
   *   5. Update filledTiles list with newly filled coordinates.
   *   6. Set prevFilledTiles to the size of filledTiles before this fill operation.
   *   7. Update prevFilledDistance to current distance.
   * Related Features: sourceCell, filledTiles, prevFilledDistance, prevFilledTiles fields
   * Related Classes: TerminationCell, FillableCell, Pipe, Coordinate, Direction
   * Input: distance : int - the maximum distance (in steps) from source to fill
   * Output: void
   * Pre-condition: distance >= 0
   * Post-condition: All pipes within the given distance that form a connected path from source are marked as filled.
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT
   */
  public void fillTiles(final int distance)
  {
    if (getPrevFilledDistance() == null || getPrevFilledDistance() == 0) {
      fillBeginTile();
    }
    
    setPrevFilledTiles(getFilledTiles().size());
    
    Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
    
    EList<Coordinate> queue = new BasicEList<Coordinate>();
    EList<Coordinate> visited = new BasicEList<Coordinate>();
    
    Coordinate sourceCoord = getSourceCell().getCoord();
    queue.add(sourceCoord);
    visited.add(sourceCoord);
    
    int currentDist = 0;
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty() && currentDist < distance) {
      int levelSize = queue.size();
      for (int i = 0; i < levelSize; i++) {
        Coordinate current = queue.remove(0);
        Cell cell = getCell()[current.getRow()][current.getCol()];
        
        if (cell instanceof FillableCell) {
          FillableCell fillableCell = (FillableCell) cell;
          Pipe pipe = fillableCell.getPipe();
          if (pipe != null) {
            pipe.setFilled(true);
            if (!getFilledTiles().contains(current)) {
              getFilledTiles().add(current);
            }
            
            for (Direction dir : pipe.getConnections()) {
              Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
              Coordinate neighborCoord = current.add(offset);
              int nr = neighborCoord.getRow();
              int nc = neighborCoord.getCol();
              
              if (nr >= 0 && nr < getRows() && nc >= 0 && nc < getCols() && !visited.contains(neighborCoord)) {
                Cell neighborCell = getCell()[nr][nc];
                Direction opposite = helper.getOpposite(dir);
                
                if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                  FillableCell nfc = (FillableCell) neighborCell;
                  Pipe np = nfc.getPipe();
                  if (np != null && np.getConnections().contains(opposite)) {
                    visited.add(neighborCoord);
                    queue.add(neighborCoord);
                  }
                } else if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                  TerminationCell tc = (TerminationCell) neighborCell;
                  if (tc.getPointingTo() == opposite) {
                    visited.add(neighborCoord);
                    queue.add(neighborCoord);
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          }
        } else if (cell instanceof TerminationCell) {
          TerminationCell termCell = (TerminationCell) cell;
          if (!termCell.isFilled()) {
            termCell.setFilled(true);
          }
          if (!getFilledTiles().contains(current)) {
            getFilledTiles().add(current);
          }
          
          Direction dir = termCell.getPointingTo();
          Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
          Coordinate neighborCoord = current.add(offset);
          int nr = neighborCoord.getRow();
          int nc = neighborCoord.getCol();
          
          if (nr >= 0 && nr < getRows() && nc >= 0 && nc < getCols() && !visited.contains(neighborCoord)) {
            Cell neighborCell = getCell()[nr][nc];
            Direction opposite = helper.getOpposite(dir);
            
            if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
              FillableCell nfc = (FillableCell) neighborCell;
              Pipe np = nfc.getPipe();
              if (np != null && np.getConnections().contains(opposite)) {
                visited.add(neighborCoord);
                queue.add(neighborCoord);
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
      currentDist++;
    }
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
      Coordinate current = queue.remove(0);
      Cell cell = getCell()[current.getRow()][current.getCol()];
      
      if (cell instanceof FillableCell) {
        FillableCell fillableCell = (FillableCell) cell;
        Pipe pipe = fillableCell.getPipe();
        if (pipe != null) {
          pipe.setFilled(true);
          if (!getFilledTiles().contains(current)) {
            getFilledTiles().add(current);
          }
        }
      } else if (cell instanceof TerminationCell) {
        TerminationCell termCell = (TerminationCell) cell;
        if (!termCell.isFilled()) {
          termCell.setFilled(true);
        }
        if (!getFilledTiles().contains(current)) {
          getFilledTiles().add(current);
        }
      }
    }
    
    setPrevFilledDistance(distance);
  }

  /**
   * <!-- begin-user-doc -->
   * <!-- end-user-doc -->
   * <!-- begin-model-doc -->
   * Summary: Fills tiles with water up to the given distance from the source using BFS.
   * Algorithm:
   *   1. If this is the first fill (prevFilledDistance is null or 0), call fillBeginTile() to mark source as filled.
   *   2. Perform BFS from source, expanding outward up to the given distance.
   *   3. For each pipe encountered, check connectivity: water can move from pipe A to pipe B if A has a connection direction d and B has a connection in the opposite direction of d.
   *   4. Mark reachable pipes as filled.
   *   5. Update filledTiles list with newly filled coordinates.
   *   6. Set prevFilledTiles to the size of filledTiles before this fill operation.
   *   7. Update prevFilledDistance to current distance.
   * Related Features: sourceCell, filledTiles, prevFilledDistance, prevFilledTiles fields
   * Related Classes: TerminationCell, FillableCell, Pipe, Coordinate, Direction
   * Input: distance : int - the maximum distance (in steps) from source to fill
   * Output: void
   * Pre-condition: distance >= 0
   * Post-condition: All pipes within the given distance that form a connected path from source are marked as filled.
   * <!-- end-model-doc -->
   * @model annotation="http://www.ustb.edu.cn/sei/mde/EnhancedCodeGen generated='true'"
   * @generated NOT
   */
  public void fillTiles(final int distance)
  {
    if (getPrevFilledDistance() == null || getPrevFilledDistance() == 0) {
      fillBeginTile();
    }
    
    setPrevFilledTiles(getFilledTiles().size());
    
    Pa19Helper helper = Pa19Factory.eINSTANCE.createPa19Helper();
    
    EList<Coordinate> queue = new BasicEList<Coordinate>();
    EList<Coordinate> visited = new BasicEList<Coordinate>();
    
    Coordinate sourceCoord = getSourceCell().getCoord();
    queue.add(sourceCoord);
    visited.add(sourceCoord);
    
    int currentDist = 0;
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty() && currentDist < distance) {
      int levelSize = queue.size();
      for (int i = 0; i < levelSize; i++) {
        Coordinate current = queue.remove(0);
        Cell cell = getCell()[current.getRow()][current.getCol()];
        
        if (cell instanceof FillableCell) {
          FillableCell fillableCell = (FillableCell) cell;
          Pipe pipe = fillableCell.getPipe();
          if (pipe != null) {
            pipe.setFilled(true);
            if (!getFilledTiles().contains(current)) {
              getFilledTiles().add(current);
            }
            
            for (Direction dir : pipe.getConnections()) {
              Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
              Coordinate neighborCoord = current.add(offset);
              int nr = neighborCoord.getRow();
              int nc = neighborCoord.getCol();
              
              if (nr >= 0 && nr < getRows() && nc >= 0 && nc < getCols() && !visited.contains(neighborCoord)) {
                Cell neighborCell = getCell()[nr][nc];
                Direction opposite = helper.getOpposite(dir);
                
                if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
                  FillableCell nfc = (FillableCell) neighborCell;
                  Pipe np = nfc.getPipe();
                  if (np != null && np.getConnections().contains(opposite)) {
                    visited.add(neighborCoord);
                    queue.add(neighborCoord);
                  }
                } else if (neighborCell instanceof TerminationCell) {
                  TerminationCell tc = (TerminationCell) neighborCell;
                  if (tc.getPointingTo() == opposite) {
                    visited.add(neighborCoord);
                    queue.add(neighborCoord);
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          }
        } else if (cell instanceof TerminationCell) {
          TerminationCell termCell = (TerminationCell) cell;
          if (!termCell.isFilled()) {
            termCell.setFilled(true);
          }
          if (!getFilledTiles().contains(current)) {
            getFilledTiles().add(current);
          }
          
          Direction dir = termCell.getPointingTo();
          Coordinate offset = helper.getOffset(dir);
          Coordinate neighborCoord = current.add(offset);
          int nr = neighborCoord.getRow();
          int nc = neighborCoord.getCol();
          
          if (nr >= 0 && nr < getRows() && nc >= 0 && nc < getCols() && !visited.contains(neighborCoord)) {
            Cell neighborCell = getCell()[nr][nc];
            Direction opposite = helper.getOpposite(dir);
            
            if (neighborCell instanceof FillableCell) {
              FillableCell nfc = (FillableCell) neighborCell;
              Pipe np = nfc.getPipe();
              if (np != null && np.getConnections().contains(opposite)) {
                visited.add(neighborCoord);
                queue.add(neighborCoord);
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
      currentDist++;
    }
    
    while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
      Coordinate current = queue.remove(0);
      Cell cell = getCell()[current.getRow()][current.getCol()];
      
      if (cell instanceof FillableCell) {
        FillableCell fillableCell = (FillableCell) cell;
        Pipe pipe = fillableCell.getPipe();
        if (pipe != null) {
          pipe.setFilled(true);
          if (!getFilledTiles().contains(current)) {
            getFilledTiles().add(current);
          }
        }
      } else if (cell instanceof TerminationCell) {
        TerminationCell termCell = (TerminationCell) cell;
        if (!termCell.isFilled()) {
          termCell.setFilled(true);
        }
        if (!getFilledTiles().contains(current)) {
          getFilledTiles().add(current);
        }
      }
    }
    
    setPrevFilledDistance(distance);
  }
